Jonathan Bird Is One Of The World's Top Underwater Nature Cinematographers. As He Ventures Into The Blue Underworld, Be It Freshwater Or Salt, Reefs, Wrecks Or Caves, He Meets With Myriad Creatures And Gives Viewers Astonishing Facts About Them. From California To The Bahamas, Bird Captures All That Nature Has To Offer Be It Colorful Harmless Sponges Or Dangerous Sharks!
Jonathan examines the ways in which sharks engage with their habitats and divers; Jonathan and Wayne Scott Smith analyse the social interactions of dolphins, and he gets a lesson in the Bandana Game.
Jonathan dives a hundred feet beneath the ocean surface to explore caves in the Bahamas. Furthermore, he faces total darkness as he navigates the tricky underwater labyrinth.
